$comment: The upstream PIN the generated layer came from. All-empty on the hand-authored SEED: nothing was extracted, and the emptiness is the honest marker (scripts/provider-catalog.ts turns an empty `commit` into catalogVersion "0.0.0-seed"). Lane X fills these in when it lands scripts/provider-source-sync.ts, and `tagObject` records the annotated tag's own object id so a re-tag cannot silently change what "the same pin" means.
